goal: Implement dev_agent_kit/stacks.py with detect_components(repository: Path) -> list[dict] for the new inspect CLI. Inspect only root-level manifests. Report each detected Python (pyproject.toml or requirements.txt), Go (go.mod), JavaScript (package.json) and Rust (Cargo.toml) component independently; do not impose Node. Each component contains name, language, working_directory=".", manifests (relative filenames) and suggested_checks (name, argv argument array, timeout_seconds). JavaScript check suggestions must reference only existing test/lint/build/typecheck scripts and use the matching root lockfile package manager (npm, pnpm, yarn or bun). Go/Rust may suggest their idiomatic tests; Python suggests existing test tooling or no checks if unavailable. Root missing/invalid manifests must have visible diagnostics rather than silently succeeding. Read metadata only; do not execute tools, install packages, create environments, modify manifests or scan dependencies. Keep this small focused module; add tests/unit/test_stack_discovery.py for empty and mixed-language projects, package-manager selection and invalid inputs. The provided acceptance script supplies the expected public shape. Return structured results when done; keep tool calls few and batch focused reads. Change only these two permitted files.
acceptance_criteria: The supplied stack discovery acceptance script passes.
The inspect CLI can describe the kit checkout without running suggested commands.
Unit tests cover mixed stacks, manager selection and malformed input; existing regression tests pass.

policy.authorization_reference: User request on 2026-10-04 to complete executor controls, multi-repository support and real agent validation.
